text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Wishing you a year filled with happiness, 
I have prepared a modest gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what. Accessories, or maybe 
clothes? Ruby has impeccable taste, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, wait. You look empty-handed, 
though? And I don't see anything like that 
around here either.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
An invisible present... how unusual. Or is 
it something so massive that you couldn't 
bring it here?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, nothing of that sort in particular.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of inviting you to a brief 
moment of soothing comfort—afternoon tea.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
C.B.-san is a free-spirited person. Even 
for birthdays, I believe she would 
appreciate cherished memories over 
tangible gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Guess that's true. Well then, don't 
mind if I drop in!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Ruby, you adjusted things for me, didn't 
you? Both your time and your calories.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It has already been factored into my 
schedule since a month ago. I shall see 
you later, then.
